name: Kimpton Canary Hotel
insider_take: This Spanish Colonial Revival beauty sits in the heart of the American Riviera, where Hollywood glamour meets coastal sophistication.
whats_special: The Kimpton Canary occupies a historic 1920s building that once housed the Carrillo Hotel, where stars like Charlie Chaplin and Greta Garbo escaped the spotlight. Its rooftop bar offers stunning views of the Santa Barbara Harbor and Channel Islands, while the hotel's pet-friendly policy includes a nightly wine hour where even four-legged guests are welcomed with treats.
pro_tip: Book a harbor-view room on floors 5-7 for unobstructed sunset views, and time your arrival for the complimentary evening wine reception (5-6 PM daily) featuring local Santa Barbara County vintages.
dont_miss: Stroll down State Street (just steps away) for boutique shopping and gallery hopping, then catch the sunset at nearby Stearns Wharf - America's longest deep-water pier. The hotel is perfectly positioned for walking to the Santa Barbara County Courthouse's iconic clock tower and the vibrant Funk Zone's wine tasting rooms.
pros: Prime downtown Santa Barbara location within walking distance to State Street shopping and dining
Rooftop pool and bar offering panoramic views of the Santa Ynez Mountains and Pacific Ocean
Kimpton's signature pet-friendly policy with no additional fees for furry companions
Complimentary evening wine hour and morning coffee service in the lobby
cons: Limited on-site parking availability in busy downtown area
Boutique hotel size means fewer amenities than larger resort properties
